enrichDetails.description: If enabled, visits each place page to populate full details (placeId, phone, website, exact address, coordinates). Disables for faster runs that rely only on list-card data.
enrichDetails.title: Fetch full place details

language.description: Language for Google Maps interface and results.
language.title: Language

listUrl.description: A Google Maps list / search URL (e.g. https://www.google.com/maps/search/Top+hotels+in+Paris or a shareable list URL with !3e3). Required when mode is 'listUrl'.
listUrl.title: List URL

maxResults.description: Maximum number of places to return from the public list/search feed; records are emitted progressively for large lists.
maxResults.title: Max Results

mode.description: Use 'topList' for a query like 'Top hotels in Paris' or 'Best coffee in Brooklyn'. Use 'listUrl' to scrape a specific Google Maps list/search URL.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. The actor works reliably without a proxy from Apify cloud; enable proxy only if you hit rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

query.description: Curated list query — e.g. 'Top hotels in Paris', 'Best Italian restaurants in Rome', 'Things to do in Tokyo'. Required when mode is 'topList'.
query.title: Query (top list)
